hypothesis: Recently added HS300 constituents may benefit from index-inclusion visibility and passive demand, while older constituents lack this flow. A bounded continuous tenure factor may identify post-inclusion drift without relying only on a small binary event sample.
selection_basis: The definition was selected from an HS300-specific data source before reading forward returns. Feasibility showed 1,435 historical membership snapshots, 564 unique constituents, 621 detected entries, and an average of 21.18 members within the first 252 membership days from 2022 onward. Evidence: data/strategies/ai/.iterations/ai_hs300_multi_factor_rank/evidence/r245_data_feasibility.json

factor.interpretation: Higher means the stock entered the current continuous HS300 membership period more recently.
factor.pit_rule: For each date use the latest membership snapshot with query_date <= date. Membership entries and re-entries start a new tenure clock immediately after an observed absence. Use query_date as the effective date; update_date is not used. Initial members at the 2018-01-01 snapshot are left-censored with start fixed to 2018-01-01.
factor.missing_data_rule: The factor is null outside observed HS300 membership and never filled from the current membership list.
factor.universe: historical HS300 membership excluding banks and non-bank financials using the current industry snapshot

strategies.weight_rationale: The tenure signal receives 30% because it is a flow/event tilt, while the remaining 70% preserves the exact 54.5/45.5 quality-cash ratio used by the matched control.
strategies.matched_requirements: Both strategies use the same non-financial HS300 universe, tenure-factor availability filter, score limit 30, top 10 equal-weight positions, 20-day holding period, -20% stop loss, T+1 open execution and cost model.

execution.cost_stress: 4x and 5x scale all four cost components proportionally

segments.stitching: compound two independently run segment curves; skip the first return of each later segment

factor_ic.method: month-end factor value versus T+1 open to T+21 open forward return within historical non-financial HS300 members; cross-sectional Spearman rank IC

gates.D3: continuous membership-entry PIT construction verified; no current-list filling
gates.D4: at least 10 members within their first 252 tenure days on >= 80% of observed dates from 2022 onward
gates.I1: discovery mean rank IC >= 0.02 with at least 24 month-end observations
gates.I2: validation mean rank IC >= 0.01 with at least 18 month-end observations and the same positive sign
gates.G2: discovery candidate MDD is no worse than control MDD by more than 5pp
gates.G4: full-sample candidate return > 0 and >= control return
gates.G5: full-sample candidate MDD <= 40% in absolute value and no worse than control by more than 5pp
gates.G6: rolling 1-year positive rate >= 60% and no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G7: recent 12-month candidate return > 0 and MDD no worse than control by more than 5pp
gates.G8: full-sample candidate return at 4x cost is positive
gates.G9: full-sample candidate return at 5x cost is positive
gates.C1: at least 30 distinct symbols are traded across the full sample
gates.C2: the largest symbol's share of net P&L is <= 25%
gates.C3: the top three symbols' share of net P&L is <= 55%
gates.C4: the top five symbols' share of net P&L is <= 75%
gates.C5: at least 8 distinct symbols have positive P&L in the validation segment
gates.C6: the largest industry's share of gross profit is <= 45%
gates.C7: the largest single-symbol loss is <= 20% of gross profit in absolute value

decision_rule: All D, I, G and C gates must pass. Any failure means the factor is not accepted and cannot be rescued by changing the formula, decay, weights, holding period, stop loss, universe, costs or gates after seeing results.
known_limitations: Initial constituents are left-censored at the 2018-01-01 snapshot.
Membership snapshots are sparse before 2021 and daily afterward; an unobserved interim removal and re-entry can be missed.
Index-inclusion effects may be concentrated around the announcement rather than the post-membership period measured here.
The industry snapshot used to exclude financials is current rather than historical PIT.
Passing these gates would justify further paper-trading validation, not production deployment.
